content: Backlog order field differs by process: Agile/CMMI Microsoft.VSTS.Common.StackRank, Scrum Microsoft.VSTS.Common.BacklogPriority (double, background-maintained, not on form). ReorderBacklogWorkItems PATCH {project}/{team}/_apis/work/workitemsorder with ids, previousId, nextId (0 = start/end), parentId, iterationPath (iteration backlog only); returns new order values. Team route required.
